_meta.noteSpecimen: Added 2026-09-05 (effort-power reconciliation M1). A specimen (unique creature) level fed the SAME quadratic P(Theta) as the player line while costing a flat, hardcoded 100 XP per level -- so specimen power was quadratic IN EFFORT where the player's is linear, and at level 1,000 a specimen level bought identical power for a fraction of the effort. It now reads this arithmetic ladder like every other kind. first=100 matches the old flat cost exactly at level 1, so early pace is unchanged and only the late-game divergence is corrected. Pace is a balance surface -- move it here, not in code.
